usefulness.rationale: All dossier statements are blank; the only content is a single citation quote identifying Tedros as Ethiopian Director-General of the WHO, sourced to a conspiracy-oriented USAWatchdog interview page — a weak, non-authoritative source. The identity anchors (ministerships, birthplace, PhD) are asserted in metadata but not supported by any dossier claim. A reader learns only a bare title and role, with no detail on actions, and no gaps or unknowns are flagged. Not sufficient to prepare for a meeting beyond knowing his current title.
